description: 固定源 V480 七景，在同条 BF 和 clean IQ 间正交拆分误差，冻结 F0 全因子归因。

data.version: Original392005 source contract; existing R07 fixed1800 V/7 frozen validation views
data.representation: Original R07 source V480 × 7, cached BF IQ and aligned original source clean IQ. Fixed window [80:160], four 20-sample blocks.
data.tx_sets_ref: Original six known sourceTX; V trueTX validation only, no train/selection
data.actual_training_labels: No training. Two real L_s clean/received pairs for smoke. V frozen diagnosis only.
data.augmentation: Reuse all seven original source V observations, no regenerated signals.

permissions.query_use: Source clean IQ used only to construct the counterfactual. No target, OE, novel, fit, or selection.
permissions.claim_scope: Conditional true TX contributions with fixed baseline, fixed basis and oracle IQ. No deployable arm or theoretical limit.

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen original F0, cached original blind BF IQ. No G load or update.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original validated R07 source handles and exact cached reference/scene physical IDs.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen same-source BF and F0. No G training, target or OE/novel/TX access.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed all eight masks, all seven scenes. No selection or state fitting.

metric_names: TX accuracy, repairs/damage and original clean-correct retention
Relative IQ correction energy for each orthogonal component

rows.purpose: Localize missed recognition to periodically coherent, within-window contrast, or outside-window IQ.
rows.seed_notes: Fixed original record order and original F0; no new RNG or phase selection.
